description: Click an element on the active page. Give exactly one of element_index (from the latest browser_snapshot of that page; valid 30 s; page, URL, tag, name, href and position are re-checked, element_no_longer_valid when stale), selector (a fallback) or xy (pixel coordinates; not recommended). Real Playwright pointer input with actionability checks: occluded or not_actionable when covered or disabled — never a synthetic JS .click(). Reports delivery and retry.
name: browser_click
